description: Synthetic experiment labels; no clinical reagent efficacy claim. Delivery carriers X/Y/Z are distinct from vessel geometry IDs.
policy: On a seen layout, tissue protection selects Q-learning Safety and speed selects distance A*. Ask for priority when unspecified. On an unseen layout, always use distance A*.
speed_units: All robots have one movement opportunity per shared timestep. Fast means distance-A* routing; speed-route intent has reservation priority, with seeded random ties.
urgency_policy: Exactly one tumour is designated urgent. ReAct may change it only from an explicit user request. Urgency does not alter speed conflict priority or waive other SMT constraints.
dosage_policy: Synthetic maximum necessary reagent per target per deployment, aggregated across carriers. Travel consumes no reagent; at most one terminal release per carrier. Excess allocations require a revised plan, not an override.
capacity_policy: Synthetic maximum payload per robot is 60 aggregate reagent units; target dose caps remain independently enforced.

environment_sensor.description: Synthetic sensor confusion rates supplied by the experiment; not an empirically fitted calibration or confidence posterior. Prediction is independent of route safety scores.
environment_sensor.policy: A very-high sensor alert requires Q-learning Safety for all assigned robots, overriding speed intent and the unseen A* rule. User must accept this plan or cancel. Other admission constraints still apply.
